summary: Wholesale Pricing Frontend Integration - All core features working correctly. Wholesale customers see proper badges, discounted prices, and savings info. Retail customers see regular prices without wholesale elements. Non-logged-in users see 'Register to see price'.
action_items: CONFIGURATION: demo@aminochain.com is currently set as wholesale customer but was intended as retail test account per review request. Update customer tier in admin panel if retail testing is needed with this account.
critical_code_review_comments: Wholesale pricing integration correctly uses isWholesale flag from AuthContext
Product cards properly display WHOLESALE badges, crossed-out retail prices, and % OFF discount badges
Product detail page shows '25% Wholesale Discount' badge and 'You save $X.XX' message for wholesale customers
Wholesale banner properly shows custom discount percentage from customerTier context
API integration with /api/store/products/priced and /api/users/calculate-price working correctly
Non-authenticated users see 'Register to see price' as expected
context_for_next_testing_agent: Wholesale pricing is fully integrated into frontend. test@test.com has 25% custom discount, demo@aminochain.com has 20% global wholesale discount. Use super@amino.com for true retail customer testing.
